name: proto-go-raw-descriptor-shapes
description: A protoc-gen-go file binds each message and field through the serialized file descriptor it embeds, which three releases write in three shapes: a byte slice composite literal (v1.36.3), a string conversion of one (v1.36.5) and a string constant (v1.36.11). Every message and field of each file is a consumer of its declaration.
pending: references-go.9: deadset-go decodes the raw descriptor in each of its three shapes and publishes the consumer records (GO3b).
